subject: general
question:
Chetan travels from City A to City B. If Chetan drives his car at (3)/(5) th of his normal speed, then he reaches City B 52 minutes late.

Find the time (in minutes) that Chetan would have taken to travel from City A to City B if he drove at his normal speed.
solution:
**Given:**

Chetan drives at ³/₅ of his normal speed and reaches City B 52 minutes late.

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance / Speed
